method.matrix_scope: All actual source frames and every one of the41 sealed paths; row-major Unity world matrix. Parent-local=inverse(actual parent world)*actual bone world.
method.constant_rule: Exact finite component equality to first frame; zero maximum world and parent-local deltas. No epsilon, fitting, rounding, freezing or scope substitution.
method.pose_digest: SHA256 of canonical sorted compact UTF8 JSON array [{path,matrix:[16 finite Python floats]}], paths sorted by UTF16-BE bytes. First actual frame only.
method.inverse: Deterministic double-precision4x4 Gaussian-Jordan inversion with maximum-absolute pivot; singular/nonfinite rejection.
method.time_scope: Complete source frame sequence and declared selected interval; Loop must move in both full source and selected interval.
method.sealed_spec_digest: SHA256 canonical raw sealed DTO JSON sort_keys=True ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False separators comma/colon.

limitations: Source packet math only; native Blender Actions/Fcurves/Bezier handles and control-solve noise are uninspected.
Source constancy is a precondition; native strict HoldPose curve/handle admission, mapping/control/Rest and physical export proof remain mandatory.
No Blender/Unity/process/SDK/GUI/publication/source asset/workspace mutation or native success is performed or implied.
A completed numeric rejection writes false constant_source_pass and exits1; no producer pass flag is used to infer static matrices.
